ns2:course.label: Applied Jazz Instruction
ns2:course.description: Instruction at the advanced undergraduate or graduate level in voice in instruments normally associated with the jazz idiom. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 2 to 4 undergraduate hours. 2 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 undergraduate hours or 20 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Successful performance audition for the jazz faculty.
